paper_title: Novel cosmological bounds on thermally-produced axion-like particles
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper derives cosmological (Planck 2018 TT,TE,EE+lowE + BAO) bounds on thermally-produced ALPs for BOTH the axion-photon coupling g_agamma and the axion-gluon coupling Cg/fa (equivalently the EDM coupling gd). The headline marginalized 95% CL bound over the scanned mass range 1e-4 < ma/eV < 100 is g_agamma < 3.16e-8 GeV^-1 (Planck+BAO; Planck alone gives 2.84e-8). Encoded as a flat two-point bound over the mass prior range; the actual mass-dependent limit (Fig. 7, fixed-mass runs at ma = 1e-4...100 eV) is only shown graphically, tightening toward ma~10 eV and relaxing around ma~30 eV — precise per-mass numbers are not tabulated. The paper's strongest NEW result is actually the axion-GLUON bound Cg/fa < 1.06e-7 GeV^-1 (gd < 3.77e-10 GeV^-2), superseding SN1987A, but the pre-analysis hint and the requested single coupling type led to reporting AxionPhoton; extraction confidence lowered accordingly since two coupling planes are constrained. No local DM density assumed (cosmological bound, no requirement that axions saturate DM). CMB-S4 numbers quoted (gaγ ~ 1.07e-8) are projections and were excluded. | [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('summary plot') rather than the paper's own single curve | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 39)) | Vision: Traced the Planck+BAO (blue diamonds) dashed boundary from the summary plot (fig_07); region above the curve is excluded. The Planck-only curve (orange) nearly coincides except near m_a ~ 3-30 eV where it is slightly weaker (e.g. 9.5e-9 at 10 eV, 1.5e-8 at 30 eV vs blue 6e-9 and 1.1e-8). Boundary has a pronounced dip near m_a ~ 10 eV, then a bump near 30 eV before decreasing again toward 100 eV; sampled densely there. This is a bound on thermally-produced axions from CMB spectra + BAO (not a DM-density-dependent haloscope limit). The paper also constrains the axion-gluon coupling in a separate plane, not extracted here per the AxionPhoton hint. | Calibration: No calibration needed (benchmark KSVZ raw_ratio=1.28 snapped to identity)
